items.title: AWS Launches TorchNeuron to Run PyTorch Models on AWS Trainium Without Modifications
items.summary: At the recent PyTorch Conference North America 2026, Amazon introduced TorchNeuron, a native PyTorch backend that enables developers to run existing PyTorch code on AWS Trainium AI chips with virtually no code modifications. By Sergio De Simone

items.title: Podcast: Distributed LLM Inference on Kubernetes with llm-d, Wasm, & TornadoVM
items.summary: In this episode, Edoardo Vacchi discusses the evolving landscape of WebAssembly on the backend, running Java workloads on GPUs using TornadoVM, and optimizing distributed AI inference using llm-d and vLLM on Kubernetes. Edoardo explains how llm-d manages cache locality (KV and prefix caches), request routing, and batch inference across Kubernetes clusters to maximize expensive GPU utilization. By Edoardo Vacchi

items.title: Article: Agentic AI Architecture: Current Challenges and Future Opportunities
items.summary: Agentic AI architecture extends microservices and cloud-native architectures with AI agents that work with context, memory, and protocols such as MCP and A2A. The article covers bounded-context integration, task-dependent coordination strategies, new security risks, and observability needs. It expects gradual adoption alongside existing architectures, with platforms absorbing common components. By Rafał Gancarz

items.title: Tokio Releases Topcoat: A Batteries-Included Full-Stack Rust Framework
items.summary: Topcoat is an open-source, server-rendered full-stack web framework for Rust from the Tokio team, now public at version 0.9. It uses Rust expressions translated to JavaScript for reactivity instead of WebAssembly. It targets typical database-driven apps. Releases are unstable, and authentication and background jobs remain on the roadmap. By Daniel Curtis
